clips.title: The story
paras: Thyn'tel Bladeweaver sends you from Darnassus to Ratchet to search for Velinde Starsong. The Sentinels believe she took a ship across the Great Sea to the Eastern Kingdoms, and her trail leads through dangerous Horde lands.

Clues among Velinde Starsong's personal effects suggest she sought passage across the sea to the Eastern Kingdoms. Ratchet is the Barrens' only working harbor, where travelers from northern Kalimdor can arrange passage south or east without sailing from night elf lands. Thyn'tel Bladeweaver sends you south to search the harbor master's ledgers for Velinde's name.

The road to Ratchet crosses the heart of Horde lands. South of Ashenvale, orc outriders and Tauren patrols range across the Mor'shan Rampart and the dry Barrens. Ratchet is governed by the neutral Steamwheedle Cartel, whose goblin law puts trade ahead of faction rivalries. At the docks, Wharfmaster Dizzywig records every passenger and cargo crate.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Ratchet is the only port in the Barrens. Most likely Velinde found a trading vessel in Ratchet to take her to Blackwater Cove in Azeroth. We've had limited dealings with the goblins that run the port, but the master of the dock should have information about the comings and goings of ship passengers.
Follow the road southeast through Ashenvale and you will find yourself in the Barrens. Watch your step, friend, warriors of the Horde patrol the land. You will be safe at the port, though.

clips.title: Completion
paras: Traveler, eh? Must admit, we don't get much of your type out here. Looking for someone, eh? Just give me a moment, I'm sure I have it written in one of my ledgers.
Lot of people travel through here, though, so just give me a moment.
